'''Stanley William Herbert Cowley''' {{post-nominals|FRS}}<ref name=frs>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/stanley-cowley-11271/|title=Stanley Cowley |author=Anon|publisher= [[Royal Society]]|website=royalsociety.org|accessdate=16 September 2018|year=2011}}</ref> (born 1947)<ref name=whoswho>{{Who's Who | author=Anon| title=Cowley, Prof. Stanley William Herbert | id = U12102 | year = 2007 | doi =10.1093/ww/9780199540884.013.U12102 | edition = online [[Oxford University Press]]|location=Oxford}}</ref> is a British physicist, and [[Emeritus]] Professor of Solar Planetary Physics at the [[University of Leicester]].<ref name=official>{{Official URL}}</ref><ref name=le>{{cite web|url=https://www2.le.ac.uk/departments/physics/people/stancowley|year=2018|title=Professor Stan Cowley — University of Leicester|author=Anon|website=le.ac.uk|accessdate=16 September 2018|url-status=dead|archive-date=17 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917034415/https://www2.le.ac.uk/departments/physics/people/stancowley}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www2.le.ac.uk/news/blog/2011-archive/may/congratulations-to-professor-stan-cowley-frs|title=Congratulations to Professor Stan Cowley FRS — University of Leicester|author=Anon|year=2018|website=le.ac.uk|accessdate=16 September 2018|url-status=dead|archive-date=17 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917034441/https://www2.le.ac.uk/news/blog/2011-archive/may/congratulations-to-professor-stan-cowley-frs}}</ref>

==Education==
Cowley was educated at [[Caludon Castle School]], Coventry, and [[Imperial College, London]], graduating with first-class honours in physics in 1968. He was awarded a [[PhD]] degree by Imperial in 1972 for research supervised by [[James Dungey]].<ref name=imp>{{cite thesis|degree=PhD|first=Stanley William Herbert|last=Cowley|title=Self-consistent models of magnetic neutral sheets|oclc=930651468|year=1972|hdl=10044/1/16302|url=https://spiral.imperial.ac.uk/handle/10044/1/16302|website=imperial.ac.uk}}</ref>

==Career and research==
Cowley had a visiting scholarship at the [[University of Colorado]] in 1972–73 before returning to Imperial, where was appointed [[lecturer]] in 1982, [[Reader (academic rank)|reader]] in 1985 and professor in 1988. He was appointed Head of the Space and Atmospheric Physics Group at Imperial in 1990 before moving in 1996 to the [[University of Leicester]] as Head of the Radio and Space Plasma Physics group.<ref name=bio>{{cite web|url=https://www2.le.ac.uk/departments/physics/people/stancowley|title=Professor Stan Cowley|publisher=University of Leicester|accessdate=1 October 2020|url-status=dead|author=Anon|year=2020|archive-date=17 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180917034415/https://www2.le.ac.uk/departments/physics/people/stancowley}}</ref>

Cowley's primary research interest is the physical processes that shape the outer plasma environments of Earth and the magnetised planets.<ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name=bio/>

Cowley's former doctoral students include [[Emma Bunce]],<ref name=bphd/> [[Nicola Fox]],<ref name=niphd/> and [[Caitriona Jackman]].<ref name=cait/>

===Honours and awards===
*2011: Elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] (FRS)<ref name=frs/>
*2006: Awarded the Julius Bartels Medal by the [[European Geosciences Union]]
*2006: Awarded the [[Gold Medal of the Royal Astronomical Society]] for Geophysics
*1995: Elected a [[Fellow]] of the [[American Geophysical Union]] 
*1991: Awarded the [[Chapman Medal]] by the [[Royal Astronomical Society]]
